notes: Added missing schema and core logic stories to complete lifecycle coverage.

stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
stories.description: Define the data model and storage contract for bearer tokens including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_parent_id, revoked_flag, and scope. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB patterns used in GPTReader and Shared auth utilities.

stories.title: Token Expiration and Rotation Logic
stories.description: Implement core backend logic to enforce token expiration windows and support secure token rotation, including generation of successor tokens, invalidation of prior tokens upon rotation, and chain tracking for auditability.
